transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I don’t feel like myself much anymore. I’ve gotten real quiet, don’t really talk to people. And even starting my cleaning route feels harder than it should, like I’m pushing a heavy cart uphill.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to?
Yeah… sometimes. Mostly when I’m mopping after hours. I’ll hear a man’s voice say my name, or say I missed a spot. It sounds real close, like he’s by the stairwell, but… nobody’s there when I look.
Do you ever feel like someone is trying to harm you or is out to get you?

I don’t know if “harm” is the right word. But… yeah, I get the feeling people are watching me. Like the new landlord, and a couple people in my building. I keep thinking they’re using the hallway cameras to keep tabs on me, maybe talking about me. People say the cameras are just for the front door, but… I don’t know.
When you hear that voice or feel watched, are you usually feeling depressed at the same time?

Yeah… I think so. When I was at my lowest, barely eating and feeling real guilty… like I didn’t care if I woke up… that’s when I was hearing him at work too. And I was pretty sure people in the building were watching me.
Have you ever heard that voice or felt watched during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah… there was a period like that. A few weeks, maybe. I wasn’t as down as before—eating a bit more, getting through work better—but I still heard my name by the stairwell. And I still felt pretty sure the hallway cameras were… tracking me somehow.
What is the longest time you’ve heard the voice or felt watched when you were not depressed at all?

I guess… several weeks. My mood had lifted some by then, I was eating and getting through work a little better. But I still heard my name near the stairwell, and I still thought the hallway cameras were tracking me.
Have there been times when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Yeah… yes. It’s been like that for a long time. The depression part started not long after I moved, and it’s been around… maybe a year and a couple months now.
Was there ever a stretch of at least 2 weeks when you heard the voice or felt watched and you were not depressed at all?

Yeah… I think so. There were a few weeks where I wasn’t really depressed like before. I was eating more, managing work better. But I still heard my name by the stairwell, and I still felt like the hallway cameras were tracking me.
Have you ever had a time when you felt so unusually high, energized, or irritable that other people thought you were not your normal self?
Not that I can think of. I mean, I get tense sometimes, but not… high or energized like that.
During those depressed periods, did you lose interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah. I mean… things I used to like don’t really do much now. Fishing on Saturdays, crosswords with coffee… even showing the younger guys how to strip a floor right. I mostly just let it all sit. Doesn’t give me anything back.
During that time when your mood had lifted, were you completely free of depression?

Not completely, no. It was… lighter, I guess. I was eating and getting through work better for a few weeks, but I still had that stairwell thing, hearing my name, and I still thought the hallway cameras were watching me.
Have you ever heard the voice or felt watched during a time when your mood felt completely normal?

Yeah… there was a few weeks where I felt more normal, I guess. Eating better, getting through work. But I still heard my name in the stairwell, and I still felt like the hallway cameras were… keeping track of me.
About how long in total have you been hearing that voice or feeling watched?
I guess… close to a year. Maybe around eleven months, all told.
Have the voice or the feeling of being watched been going on continuously for at least 6 months?
Yeah… it’s been more than six months. About eleven months now, I think.
Since these experiences began, have you been functioning noticeably worse at work or in taking care of yourself than you were before?

Yeah… worse. My supervisor started writing me up for missed routes and mistakes I kept making cleaning. I wasn’t really keeping up with church or fishing, or checking in on people like I used to. I ended up going to the employee assistance program because I just couldn’t keep my work routine straight anymore.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?

Yeah… a couple people have said that. Like my supervisor asks which floors I finished, and I’ll start answering, but then I’m talking about the old bus route, or the garden plot, or the church basement. I can hear myself doing it sometimes… not getting back to the question.
Have you found yourself talking much less than you used to, even when you want to say more?
Yeah… I guess so. I don’t talk much anymore. Even when I’ve got something to say, I just kind of go flat and quiet. It’s… not like me.
For at least one month, were the voice, the feeling of being watched, and your trouble staying on topic all happening during the same period?
Yeah… it’s been more than a month. The voices and that feeling like I’m being watched… that’s been going on maybe 11 months now. The trouble staying on topic was around in that same time, yeah.
Have you been showing less facial expression or emotional reaction than you used to?
Yeah… I think so. People say I look kind of blank. I don’t really react much. I just go quiet, flat… and even starting my cleaning route feels like I’m pushing a loaded cart uphill.
During the time since the voice and the feeling of being watched began, was there ever a period when you were not depressed at all?

Yeah… there was a few weeks where I wasn’t as down. I was eating a little better, getting through work more. But the voice was still there sometimes, like in the stairwell, and I still felt like the hallway cameras were tracking me.
